Find the perfect order of a distinct set of symbols!

Depending on the order is the system's performance.
Each symbol can only be present once in the output sequence.

The symbols with their performance properties:
A = yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol
B = yields best performance if not preceded by symbol A or C
C = yields best performance when not being the last symbol
D = yields best performance when being the first symbol
E = yields best performance next to symbol B

The perfect order for this distinct set of symbols would be D-E-B-C-A. This order ensures that each symbol is only present once and maximizes the performance of each symbol. D yields best performance when being the first symbol, so it should come first. E yields best performance next to symbol B, so it should come after D. B yields best performance if not preceded by symbol A or C, so it should come after E. C yields best performance when not being the last symbol, so it should come before A. Finally, A yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol, so it should come last.
